Class ApplicationState

java.lang.Object
com.duck.ApplicationState
public class ApplicationState extends Object
Singleton that owns the primary model managers (TransactionManager, BudgetManager, SavingGoalsManager, AccountManager) and coordinates event propagation across the application. Registers internal listeners for budget threshold/exceeded events and goal completion events to show alert dialogs.
